registered_claim_authority: One self-contained GitHub Issue #240 CLAIM envelope validated against the operational immutable task publication for ordinary work or the exact lane-pinned retained publication for an active execution cohort.
execution_record_compatibility: research_execution_records/<task-id>/<execution-record-id>.json may preserve/freeze execution provenance but is not a mandatory pre-claim remote write
runtime_event_authority: GitHub Issue #240 issue comments authenticated by server comment metadata and separately authorized by research_control_event_authorization.json; the JSON event body is payload, not its own authentication or authorization envelope

server_event_envelope.normalized_github_envelope_from_external: REJECT; LIVE AUTHORITY MUST ENTER AS RAW ISSUE #240 COMMENT OBJECTS
server_event_envelope.bare_event_compatibility: Allowed only for explicit legacy replay/test primitives; not live authority for immutably registered tasks

parallel_execution_dispatch.activation: ACTIVE cohort record exists for task

driver_review_followup.zero_task_exception: canonical current parent Objective head already CLOSED
driver_review_followup.task_publication: automatic materializer publishes one or more immutable V2 task records in the same Driver-review subflow
driver_review_followup.ordinary_terminality: terminal Driver disposition AND follow-up barrier ready
driver_review_followup.parallel_terminality: terminal exact-set synthesis AND every governed reviewed result follow-up barrier ready

selection_rule: For tasks without an active execution cohort, use the historical state/priority/leverage/staleness ordering over the merged canonical view. AWAITING_REVIEW and COMPLETE are never selected. A post-cutover Driver review whose automatic follow-up packet is missing or invalid stays inside AWAITING_REVIEW even when the review disposition itself is terminal. When an ACTIVE cohort exists, canonical task status is projected to COHORT_ACTIVE and task-global owner authority is suppressed; lane dispatch handles evidence-incomplete lanes. Live events must come from raw server-authenticated Issue #240 comments whose exact server actor is authorized.
interaction_budget: Authentication and actor authorization reuse the same Issue #240 event stream. The review follow-up rule adds one bounded semantic transaction only at the actual Driver review: preflight a gate/taskset spec, publish the next immutable taskbook/taskset, and freeze one follow-up packet. It does not introduce heartbeat, CI polling, review polling, or moving-main chase.
